panels.title: Orders and sales (orders picked at the top: live or test)
Store up (local)
panels.description: The storefront container answering on this host.

panels.title: Orders to ship
panels.description: Paid orders not yet marked shipped.

panels.title: Oldest unshipped
panels.description: Time since the oldest unshipped order was paid. No value: nothing to ship.

panels.title: Sales, 30 days
panels.description: Net of refunds, by the day each order was paid (shop's local time).

panels.title: Average order, 30 days
panels.description: No value until something sells.

panels.title: Sales per day
panels.description: Last 30 local days, net of refunds.

panels.title: Orders by status
panels.description: Every order ever. pending: checkout open; expired or cancelled: never paid.

panels.title: Products on sale
panels.description: Visible products, stock-tracked or not.

panels.title: In stock
panels.description: Visible, stock-tracked products with at least one left.

panels.title: Sold out
panels.description: Visible, stock-tracked products with none left: customers see them as sold out.

panels.title: Units in stock
panels.description: Visible products only.

panels.title: Stock at shop prices
panels.description: Visible units in stock times their shop price.

panels.title: Hidden products
panels.description: Not shown in the shop (drafts, retired or not imported for sale).

panels.title: Hidden stock units
panels.description: Units counted in stock on hidden products: stock nobody can buy.

panels.title: Nearly sold out (visible products)
panels.description: Visible, stock-tracked products with 2 or fewer left (STORE_LOW_STOCK in collect_status.py), sold out first.

panels.title: Products by kind
panels.description: Untracked: made to order or supplier-backed, with no stock count.

panels.title: Google search (poke6s.com, from Search Console; Google's numbers run 2-3 days behind)
Clicks, 7 days
panels.description: Clicks from Google search results to poke6s.com.

panels.title: Shown in results, 28 days
panels.description: Impressions: times a poke6s.com page appeared in someone's Google results.

panels.title: Click rate, 28 days
panels.description: Clicks divided by times shown.

panels.title: Average position, 28 days
panels.description: Where poke6s.com ranked on average, weighted by times shown. 1 is the top result; 1-10 is Google's first page. Lower is better.

panels.title: Pages indexed
panels.description: Pages from the store's sitemap that Google has indexed (can show up in search). Each page is checked about once a day; the table below lists the rest.

panels.title: Sitemap last read
panels.description: When Google last read https://poke6s.com/sitemap.xml.

panels.title: Search data updated
panels.description: When the collector last fetched from Search Console (every 6 hours). Older than a day: check logs/monitoring_collector.log.

panels.title: Google search per day
panels.description: Per UTC day, last 28 days. The newest 2-3 days are still filling in.

panels.title: Top searches, 28 days
panels.description: The 20 searches that showed poke6s.com most. Google hides searches made by very few people, so these don't add up to the totals.

panels.title: Sitemap pages not indexed yet
panels.description: Google's own wording. 'Discovered - currently not indexed': Google knows the page and will crawl it when it gets round to it. 'URL is unknown to Google': not found yet. New sites take days to weeks; nothing to fix unless a page stays out for a month.
